entry.name: jit.gl.tf
entry.digest: Manage transform feedback on geometric meshes
entry.description: The jit.gl.tf object binds to a jit.gl.mesh object, takes input from jit.gl.buffer objects, and uses a shader program defined in a jit.gl.shader object to apply a transform feedback effect on the mesh geometry.

arguments.name: numbuffers
arguments.description: The number of inlets to create. Each inlet can bind to a. The maximum is 8, although the actual maximum number of feedback buffers is hardware dependent, usually 4.

attributes.name: annotation

attributes.name: bufnames
attributes.digest: Buffer Object Name List
attributes.description: Currently read only. Displays the list of buffers bound to theobject. Order of buffers reflects bound inlets from left to right.

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: enable
attributes.digest: Enable Transform Feedback
attributes.description: Enables transform feedback when set to 1. When disabled, the bound input buffer is passed in its intial state.It is recommended to disable this before modifying input buffers and reenable it after making changes. Changing input buffer state while enabled may result in unexpected behavior.

attributes.digest: Initial Primitive Count
attributes.description: The initial number of primitives that will be passed to the transform feedback stage. Useful for particle simulations when used in conjunction with geometry shaders to create emitters. If set to 0, the entire buffer is passed on enable.
